changelog: Prefer the bundled Search1API MCP tools, add browser-based CLI login and self-update guidance, document fetch-by-result-ID workflows, and remove the retired reasoning command.
summary: Live web search, page retrieval, news, sitemap discovery, and trending topics through Search1API. Use this skill whenever the user wants to search the web, look something up, research a topic, read or summarize a URL, check current news, explore a site's links, see trending topics, or check API balance. Trigger on phrases like "search for", "look up", "find out about", "what's happening with", "any news on", "what does this link say", "read this page", "summarize this URL", "trending on GitHub", or when the user shares a bare URL. Prefer the bundled Search1API MCP tools when available and fall back to the search1api CLI (`s1`).
